title: G Request Show
description: G Request Entertainment is a registered Irish company which was founded in 2005. Our main aim is to promote Irish musicians and help creative people in showcasing their talents on television. During 2005, we decided to set up a program in Tramore, Co. Waterford. What encouraged us to develop this community program, was that we thought Tramore was such a quiet place and there were little social activities offered for the youth within community development at the weekends. We thought that by offering a social event every weekend it would help benefit the community. Our activities and the shows we organized were able to bring both the Irish and the migrants of the community together and furthermore helped to enhance the cultural interests between the two different cultures through entertainment. In 2006 we thought of the possibility of expanding it into a nationwide program due to the encouragement and positive feedback from the public in response to our programs, hence we have traveled to sixteen counties within Ireland portraying our ideas. To date, we have achieved our main aim, to be able to broadcast our program on Sky platform and also be able to achieve our permanent production resident studio that includes a live audience, production equipment and professional men and women trained in the field, working with our organization.

title: Bobby G. Can't Swim
description: Bobby G. lives life on the edge in this real, raw New York street drama. Bobby is a small-time coke dealer, always on the hustle but rarely successful. He lives in Hell's Kitchen with his Puerto Rican girlfriend Lucy, who makes ends meet as a prostitute. A typical day finds Bobby selling $20 bags to neighborhood locals and passing cars. A yuppie kid looking to score a kilo of coke approaches him to broker a deal and Bobby sees the opportunity of a lifetime to make some real money. His rough days may just be over. With the tidy profit he could even leave the business. Playing out of his league, Bobby arranges to get the kilo from Astro, a fearsome, high-level drug dealer. Though Lucy announces that she's decided to go back to Puerto Rico and pleads with him to make a fresh start too, Bobby is sticking to his deal and isn't going anywhere now, convinced he'll be 'livin' large in a matter a' days. "On deal day the client gets nervous and the plan goes awry with Bobby turning over the merchandise without being able to hold on to the cash. He now fears for his life unless he can come up with the money, fast, to pay back Astro. Seized with panic Bobby seeks out an acquaintance, Dollar Bill, who puts him in touch with a mob figure who needs somebody "whacked" and is willing to pay big bucks for it too. Though Bobby has never fired a gun in his life, he carries out the execution. The act plunges him into a state of shock and torment verging on madness. In the ensuing hours, Bobby, his mind in a daze, will find redemption in a bizarre journey involving a homeless woman, the Hudson River, and a blind street-peddler named Popeet. He will also learn, that what fate may give, she is just as free to take away.

title: A 60 km/h
description: The Citroen Méhari is a lightweight all-terrain vehicle: 600 cc, two-cylinder and 28 HP, with a maximum speed of 60 kilometers (37 miles) per hour. Divorced and lonely, a Uruguayan named Mario Sabah decided to realize a longtime dream for his 50th birthday and tour the world in this car. So he quit his job and fixed up the blue Méhari that once served as the family wagon. Together with a camera and his two sons, he then embarked on a 150,000-kilometer (93,000-mile) journey across 45 countries and five continents. Once on the road, it doesn't take long for tensions to mount. After a clash of personalities halfway through Latin America, Mario continues alone, all the way to Canada. Sometimes he drives 600 kilometers at a stretch without even realizing it. "Do not ask me what happened in the middle, because I cannot tell." Once he is way up north, he puts the Méhari on the boat to Spain, and from there he travels through Europe, Asia and even Australia, defying heat, rain, dirt and all forms of chaos along the way - with plenty of stamina, far too little money and at a speed that's crucial to the story. In the words of his son Mattias, "At 60 kilometers per hour, you're like a chameleon. You go slowly, transforming along with the landscape you're going through."

description: 17 year old schoolgirl Sakura visits a Samurai theme park called Survival Land with her friends where they're supposed to go up against some cosplayers dressed as samurai but things go horribly wrong when one of the cosplayers gets infected after finding a strange flower in the theme park's grounds and cutting it with his sword. title: I Wish I Never Met You
description: Lauren Thomas is turning 40 and no one is more excited than her. She is married to an amazing husband, a true provider and father: Andrew Thomas. Andrew's brother, Franklin, is in a wheelchair due to a military attack. His wife, Mahogany, is currently pregnant with their first child. The two couples, along with three other couples and a few friends, are celebrating Lauren's birthday during the holidays since she is a Christmas baby. However, once the other women grow tired of Lauren bragging about her success, even though she is a stay-at-home wife, attitudes and snide comments take control. Over the course of the evening, things escalate and the entire cast gradually gets involved in the free-for-all until everything hits the proverbial fan. Everyone has dealt with someone that they wish they never met. What happens when you have more than a dozen of them in the same house? Find out in "I Wish I Never Met You."

title: Magtskifte i straffelejren - opgøret i Sønderjylland
description: After the 2. world war 3500 men from the german minority in the southern part of Jutland in Denmark where sent to the prisoner camp - "Faarhus". Before and during the war they had been heavily involved in national socialism and supporting the German occupation of Denmark from 1940-45. Now they had to pay for their loyalty against Denmark. Members of the german minority in Denmark is telling their families story in this documentary, with archive footage never shown before on television.

title: I Will... I Will... For Now
description: Elliott Gould and Diane Keaton take out a lease on love with an option to buy in this glossy romantic comedy costarring Paul Sorvino, Victoria Principal and Candy Clark. Unhappily divorced after 10 years of marriage, Les Bingham (Gould) finally convinces his ex-wife Katie (Keaton) to give him another shot. Reluctantly agreeing to a legal arrangement instead of a wedding vow, Les signs a six-month contract, unaware his lawyer (Sorvino) also loves Katie and plans to use the wiles of their sexy neighbor (Principal) to bust up the Binghams for good. Cowritten and directed by Norman Panama (How to Commit Marriage), I Will... I Will... For Now was produced by George Barrie, CEO of Fabergé. A musician-turned-businessman, Barrie would produce over a dozen films, earning Oscar nominations for "All That Love Went to Waste" (A Touch of Class, 1973) and "Now That We're in Love" (Whiffs, 1975), two songs he wrote with Sammy Cahn.

description: For three years, Celine Stafford has poured her heart into her marriage with Simon Porter. Yet instead of cherishing her, Simon has lavished all his attention on her adoptive sister, Wendy. Then, an unexpected accident erases Celine's memories. Free from the pain of unrequited love, she decides to leave Simon. Only now does he realize he cannot live without her—and will stop at nothing to win her heart again.

title: I Am What I Play
description: From the 1960s to the 1980s, the rock radio DJ played an unprecedented creative role in the rock music world. I Am What I Play profiles four disc jockeys in major markets during this period: their programming, their politics and their deep connections with musicians and fans in the heyday of rock radio. Where are they now - and how did they reinvent themselves as the medium changed? Featuring the music of The Ramones, Joni Mitchell, Rush, David Bowie, The Cars, The Sonics and more.

title: Do I love you, robot, do I?
description: Anthropomorphic robots are increasingly being introduced into our lives: they meet us at the reception, educate children and even live in families as partners. Scientists are trying to make robots as human-like as possible. In the late 80s, scientists studying the emotional reaction of people to robots discovered the "uncanny valley effect": the most humanoid robots caused dislike and even fear in people. But what will happen when they become indistinguishable from a person? And will they?

title: I Razor
description: Told from the perspective of a former scientist turned wandering telepathic man-child, I Razor is the story of one man's quest to regain his lost humanity. Gregory Fleer, a young scientist who has developed a new brain-altering substance called I Razor, is transformed by his own experiment and must negotiate his way through a world twisted beyond recognition by his altered perceptions. The film begins with Dr. Fleer already transformed, and teamed with his equally afflicted companion The Professor, who possesses certain inexplicable magic powers. Together, the Sergeant and Professor experience visions, perform music, and take a dark journey through a world populated by a tribe of fellow "freaks" and their leader, the phantasmagoric Mother Skinny, along with her right hand subhuman creation, The Homunculus. When the Professor abandons the Sergeant, the Sergeant finds some solace in the natural world, but his yearning to reclaim what he believes to be his lost identity unwittingly draws him back into the fray of society, where a struggle between good and evil awaits him.

title: I Travel Because I Have to, I Come Back Because I Love You
description: A geologist is sent to an isolated region in the Northeast of Brazil to survey water sources, but begins to feel a a sense of abandonment and loneliness.

title: I Am
description: When a young woman suffering from memory loss begins having flashbacks of her past, she discovers that her so called husband is harboring a dark secret.

title: I Feel Fine.
description: Ozzy Taylor, a charismatic high school teen, discovers he can't control his intrusive thoughts, setting off a life-changing shift in his destiny.

title: I Live as I Please
description: A young farmer, with a magnificent voice, receives an invitation to present himself in a large theater to be hired. In reality, the invitation is a joke made by his cousin.

title: Naruto: Shippuden [Hindi]
description: Naruto Uzumaki, is a loud, hyperactive, adolescent ninja who constantly searches for approval and recognition, as well as to become Hokage, who is acknowledged as the leader and strongest of all ninja in the village.

title: To Tulsa and Back: On Tour with J.J. Cale
description: There's not really a plot, since this is a Documentary. In my opinion, it's a very good, very entertaining, documentary of the second half of the 2004 JJ Cale Band tour. I'm Rocky, the piano player in the band. It's really accurate, factual and honest. Cale has somehow got a reputation as a recluse, which is undeserved. The fact is: he has always avoided fame, since he thinks, correctly, that fame gets in the way of freedom and friendship. For this film, he set that aside and stepped out for his fans and friends. The John Cale I have known since 1957 is the John Cale you will see in this film. Many of the mysteries people have been curious about are made plain, even the true story of where the nickname "JJ" came from (the story in the various "Histories of Rock" is inaccurate). There's plenty of really good concert footage and some charming episodes of just John, doodling on guitar and singing his songs, in parking lots and back rooms. You will get to know the supporting cast, from band members to sound guys and roadies, members of the management team and friends sitting in. This DVD is an absolute must for anybody who was ever curious about the man behind the music they love. I think the fact that the film crew came over from Munich added much to the effectiveness of the film, since they were obviously charmed by Americans and the American countryside. There's also footage from the 2004 Crossroads Festival, from the first half of the tour, and interviews with Eric Clapton, who sat in with us on the Saturday.

With this new-found perspective on life and the feel-good idea of saving people, Kevin and Kate start running towards any trouble they can find. description: This TV series is based on the books and works of R. K. Laxman. The episodes and incidents would involve happenings in the life of the common man as depicted by Laxman over the years. Meek and silent , the common man is a witness to everything: scheming politicians, gossiping housewives and rapacious bureaucrats.

title: K Around the World
description: Each episode takes place in a different destination, which follows the journey step by step, from external environments to interior. title: Stairway to Power
description: Anna is a waitress living poor life in Czech countryside when her whole life breaks down. She moves to Prague and step by step moves up, all the way to the highest political levels and bedroom of minister Tomas Vichr. It's loosely inspired by Czech political affair in 2000s.

title: Puteshestvie k tsentru dushi
description: Saga about the lives of two young women, Rita and Vera, who became closest friends at a crucial historical moment of USSR's collapse. The story covers twenty years of their life. Because of the love for the same man, Maksim, Rita and Vera turn from the best friends into deadly enemies, dangerous for each other. Bitterly envious of Rita, insidious Vera is dreaming to get her hands not only on Rita's love, but also on her money and her life. At the same time, Rita wishes to start her life from scratch. And one day fate gives each of them a unique chance: to start their life anew. However, old grievances and sins do not allow Vera to forget about the past and stop hating her more successful and pure friend Rita.

title: A.S.K.
description: Azra and Kerem is a couple who meets Sebnem, however Sebnem doesn't know they're together. Sebnem has cancer, the doctor said she will die soon. Sebnem is in love with Kerem. Kerem and Azra decides to get Kerem in a relationship with Sebnem.

title: Love Song for Illusion
description: A fantasy historical drama romance that crosses between a man with two opposite personalities and a woman who loves him, fresh love and fierce obsession.

title: Voice: Sculpting Sound with Maja S. K. Ratkje
description: The film follows the Norwegian musician/ composer/ sound artist Maja Solveig Kjelstrup Ratkje through the seasons all over Europe, presenting the variety and universalism of her work. Performances, sound recordings, and intimate personal scenes are composed into a complex portrait of an uncompromising artist challenged between conflicting poles of family and vocation. On several levels, a film about an individual's voice whose vigor and enthusiasm are increasingly passed on to the viewer.

title: Pinocchio 3000
description: The year is 3000. Geppetto, with the help of his faithful assistant, Spencer the cyber penguin, and by the holographic fairy Cyberina, creates Pinocchio, a prototype super-robot equipped for emotions.

title: Modeonpameo [Hindi]
description: In search of inspiration, rock band "Excellent Souls" - Lee Min Ki (Lee Hong Ki), Kang Hyeok (Park Min Woo), Yoo Han Cheol (Lee Si Un) - goes on hiatus deep in the countryside. To their surprise, the village elder is none other than Kang Yoon Hee (Honey Lee), a zippy woman who's not only the town's first female leader, but also the youngest. She also just so happens to be bandleader Min Ki's first love. Amidst a rural backdrop, these scrappy rockers take stock of what stirs their passions - both musical and romantic.

title: Ugly Alert
description: Joon-soo is sent to prison for a murder he didn't commit. During his incarceration, Joon-soo is taught how to sew. After his release, Joon-soo is hired by a fashion company. Joon-soo eventually falls in love with a co-worker named Do-hee.

title: L Storm
description: Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) investigator William Luk and Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) officer Lau Po-keung are respectively investigating a corruption and money laundering case, but are unable to find any clues. At this time, Ching Tak-ming of ICAC's L Team (Internal Disciplinary Investigation Team) receives a report from Eva Ng, claiming Luk has accepted a bribe of HK$12 million. Unable to provide an explanation, Luk was immediately suspended from his duties. Lau discovers that Luk was framed which is inextricably linked to the money laundering case he has been investigating. At the same time, Lau also suspects bank director Yau Chi-san assisting the mastermind of a criminal organization, Wong Hoi-wo, in money laundering. Chinese Anti-Corruption Bureau Director Hong Liang arrives in Hong Kong to provide important intel for Lau, revealing that mainland Chinese corrupt officials are involved in the money laundering case. title: Vice Ganda, bakit pagod na pagod sa Laro Laro Pick?!
description:
Dahil papalapit na Pasko, mag-practice na para sa paparating na mga Christmas parties. Perfect sa intermission number ang ‘Meme’ dance challenge ng Showtime Baby Dolls. Ang trio naman nina Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga, at Brent Manalo nag-practice na ng caroling. Si Ryan Bang, may natanggap daw na Christmas gift mula kay Ogie Alcasid last year na never niya malilimutan.

Sa 'Miss Q and A', talino at wit ang puhunan sa entablado para maputungan ng korona sa ulo. Sumabak sa talakan sina Louie Chua, isang breadwinner na sanay lumaban para sa pamilya; Klara Espedido, ang academic achiever na mahusay rin na manunulat, at Rubi Serenio, na pagme-makeup ang bread and butter.

Ang tatlong kandidata, lumiwanag ang mga mata nang masilayan ang idol nila, walang iba kund si Vice Ganda. Si Louie, hindi pinalampas ang pagkakataong makapagbigay ng mensahe ng pasasalamat kay Meme, “Thank you for lifting my personality and also encouraging me to keep pushing everyday.”

Maya-maya pa, mas kinilala nina Vice, Vhong Navarro at Ogie Alcasid ang mga kandidata. Si Klara, nagbahagi ng isang alamat na siya mismo ang sumulat, habang si Rubi naman ay game na sinipat ang mukha ni Ogie para alamin kung anong makeup look ang babagay rito.

Sa Tumpak Ganern round, si Rubi ang nalotlot sa laban habang sina Louie at Klara ang umabante sa Wit Lang para subukan kung sino ang mas may bitaw sa talakan.

Ngayong Teacher's Month, saluduhan natin ang mga gurong may malaking puso para sa serbisyo at sa mga kabataan. Hindi lang aral ang ibinibigay nila kundi pagmamahal at suporta. Kaya this Friday, mga Special Needs Education teachers ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Teacher Rose, na maituturing na hero sa classroom. Kamakailan lang, nagtamo siya ng injury matapos magwala ang isa niyang estudyante, patunay na extra lakas ng loob ang kailangan sa napili niyang propesyon. Kaya nanawagan si Vice Ganda para sa mas maayos na insurance at protection para sa mga guro, lalo na sa mga Special Needs Education teachers.

Pagkatapos ng mga challenges at mahaba-habang ‘Laro Laro Pick’ final round na ikinapagod ni Meme, kay Teacher Rose talaga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante.

Sa jackpot round, mas idinetalye ni Teacher Rose ang nangyari sa kanyang injury.Iniligtas pala niya ang isang estudyanteng nagwala at muntik nang masagasaan, kaya sa kanyang tapang at malasakit bilang guro, mas lalo siyang hinangaan.

Para may pandagdag sa gastusin, sinugalan niya ang ₱150,000 POT question tungkol sa ibig sabihin ng NCAP, ang programa ng MMDA. Makakapuntos kaya si Teacher Rose at maiuuwi ang POT money?

title: P-POP Domination
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

title: DPWH?! Jhong, ginatungan ang pamumuksa ni Ion kay Vice
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Pau Chiu
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Miss Q&A 3rd Weekly Finals
description:
Matutuloy na ang pagkikita ng dalawang icons ng noontime at komedya, 'Meme' Vice Ganda at 'Bossing' Vic Sotto. Samantala, mga Miss Q and A weekly finalists ang ka-date mo, at siguradong ma-i-in love ka sa mga talak nilang spot-on at matatalino. Unang tapak pa lang sa entablado, agad agad ay ready to slay and give their best sina Bb. Talinghaga, Rhain Boyonon, Mama Dhel, Jers Sabado, Raux Araneta, at Agua Gonzales.

Nasubok ang kaalaman ng ladies sa mga tanong na may kinalaman sa mga sangay ng gobyerno. Sina Mama Dhel at Rhaine ang 'chumukchak' sa final round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, "Sinong mas matalino? Ikaw o AI?"

Matalino ang sagot ni Rhain, na itinanghal na Miss Q&A TalakiTalk of the week!

Ang kabataan na masipag at may pangarap sa buhay, siguradong magtatagumpay. Mga estudyang kumukuha ng vocational courses, sumugal sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Enjoy ang kuwentuhan with Dagul, na ipinagmamalaki ang skills sa carpentry. Isinabuhay naman ni Dominick ang salitang versatility dahil sa dami ng talent na entry.

Pinaghandaan naman ng It's Showtime hosts act-song entries nila sa You Gotta Lyric round. May moment ang DaCkie tandem nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. At sina at MC at Lassy, bagay rin ba na maging mag-jowa?

Pito ang naka-survive sa It's Giving, pero isa lang ang nakapasa sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay si Ced. Pangarap niya, magkaroon ng malaking ambag sa pamilya. At ito na nga 'yun! Naniniwala siyang malaking ambag na ang P20,000 kaya tinanggap ni Ced ang nasabing Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Napa-KEMBOT at napa-OOOH LA LA na ang buong bayan kaya may bagong assignment sa sayawan. Ihanda ang bewang at ang energy para sa todong galawan dahil sa bagong dance craze na sinimulan ng Showtime Baby Dolls. Bagong kanta nila titled "Meme" ang bagong sasabayan sa sayawan!

Kapag wit at talakan ang subject, mga accla ay valedictorian. Kaya deserve koronahan. Sina Jemzian Seco, Kea Marie Kipling, at Josh De Leon ang sumabak sa Miss Q and A examination kung saan kailangan nilang mapahanga ang buong nation sa pagsagot sa mga playtime questions.

Kahit napagod sa biyahe na tumagal dahil sa baha, laban pa rin si Jemzian. Si Kea naman ay isang optometrist na Rank 7 sa board exam. At pinatunayan nga niya ang pagiging brainy nang mapa-wow niya si Vice Ganda dahil hindi pa man tapos basahin ang tanong ay agad siyang nakasagot—complete with a full explanation!

Sina Kea at Jemzian ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At para bang meant to be ang nabunot na tanong ni Kea, “Kung isa kang optometrist, anong ia-advise mo sa pasyente kapag sinabi niyang malabo ang kanyang third eye?”

Pero mas meant to be ang korona kay Jemzian, na tumatak sa mga hurado at Madang People dahil sa nagkandaligaw-ligaw niyang sagot sa tanong na, “Anong mas masakit? Bigyan ka ng mag-asawang sampal o sampalin ka ng mag-asawa?”

Mapa-araw o gabi, sila ang tagabantay ng safety. Sila ang mga hardworking security guards mula Pasig City.

Inspirasyon ni Koriks ang limang anak. Kaya para sa kanilang pag-aaral, willing siyang sumugal para sa ₱200,000 POT money. Kinumbinsi naman siya nina Brent Manalo, Ralph de Leon, at ng Baby Dolls na kunin ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer sa pamamagitan ng dance number.

Pero sa huli, pinakinggan ni Koriks ang gusto ng anak na subukan ang POT question. Dahil gusto ni Meme Vice na masayang umuwi si Koriks, binigyan niya ito ng sampung libo.

title: Miss Q&A Arah at Jhong, binalikan ang pagkikita nila noon
description:
Para bang inatake ng mga langgam ang buong studio dahil sa sweetness nina Bianca De Vera at Dustin Yu, na sa tinginan pa lang ay walang sinabi ang tikoy sa sobrang lagkit. Ano nga ba ang pinakakilig na ginagawa nila sa isa't isa? Kung si Dustin ay kinikilig sa luto ni Bianca, si Bianca naman ay solb na ang kilig sa ngiti pa lang ni Dustin.

Nag-hello ang mga reyna na ready to claim the korona sa Miss Q and A. Meet Anora Laforteza ng Pampanga, Ian Torres ng Manila, at Arah David ng Taguig. Baon nila ay wit na super big at personality na kaibig-ibig.

Pati si Jhong Hilario ay hindi nakaiwas sa charisma ng fangirl na si Arah. Lotlot man siya sa kompetisyon, feeling winner pa rin si Arah dahil sa moments nila ni Kuys Jhong. Samantala, 'may bitaw' ang talak nina Ian at Anora as they faced their respective questions sa Wit Lang round.

Nabunot ni Ian ang tanong na, "Sino ang mas badtrip kainuman, 'yung tumatakas o 'yung natutulog?" As a kanin lover, napangiti si Anora sa nabunot niyang tanong, "Ano ang mas bad trip? Walang ulam o walang sinaing?"

Parang tumatawag ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kaya napasugod ang mga taga-Parang, Marikina.

Agad bumuhos ang emosyon sa laro dahil sa life story ni player Kalbo, na tinitiis ang pagod at hirap para tulungan ang mga pamangkin sa kanilang mga pangarap. Samantala, si Darren Espanto, humingi ng space kay Jackie Gonzaga. Our DaCkie hearts! Huhu! Pero mabuti na lang aktingan lang 'to!

Sa pagtitinda ng prutas itinataguyod ni Eka at ng mister niya ang pamilya. Dito sa Laro Laro Pick, wish niya sana'y magbunga nang magandang biyaya ang kanyang pagpili kung tatanggapin ang Li-Pot offer o susugalan ang tanong para sa POT money.

title: Ralph, na-ATTRACT kay Miss Q&A Havana?
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

description:
Bumisita ang bandang Teeth para sa isang masayang rakrakan! At kahit certified rockers ang peg, bigla namang lumambot ang kanilang galawan nang sumabak sila sa trending “Meme” dance challenge—from rakrakan to dance cuties real quick!

Rated 5/5 stars ang talak ng mga acclang rumeresbak sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan. Hot and fierce ang arrive nina Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Rocky Cueva, at Jhon Vincent Cahulogan, na pare-parehong grateful sa second chance na sumalang sa chukchakan.

Pagkatapos ng hayop sa galing na three-way face-off, ang Top 2 na sina Jhon Vincent at Heaven ang umabante sa Beklamation kung saan napahugot naman sila sa tanong na, "May nagmamahal bang bumibitaw?"

Hospitality Management students ang nagdala ng campus energy sa Laro Laro Pick! Nakilala natin si Jibi, na mahilig sa vlogging at nagbigay pa ng sample ng kanyang bartending skills na bahagi ng kanyang kurso. Ipinagmamalaki naman ni AJ ang kanyang sipag sa academics bilang isang Dean’s Lister.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
To start the month of October, nagpasiklab sa "It's Showtime" stage ang six-member Japanese dance and vocal boy band na Be:First. Sa unang araw ng Oktubre, entertainment ay libre at sagot 'yan ng mga beki na palaban sa "Miss Q and A." Walang aatrasan sa talakan sina Jouji Medina, Jane Estolora, at Ayesa Pido Quilang.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, sakto sa BER months, 'Santa Claus 'scamming' to town' daw ang bagay na kanta para kay Jouji at sa jowa nito dahil parang hindi tugma ang mga kuwento. Si Jane naman, very Barbie ang awrahan kaya pinarampa ni Meme sa harapan. Action star na nag-transition naman ang dating ni Ayesa sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, at ang boses daw nito para bang tunog tsismosa.

Araw ito nina Ayesa at Jouji dahil sila ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Nag-loading man nang bahagya, naitawid pa rin ni Jane ang talak sa tanong na, "Saan dadaan si Santa Claus kung wala namang chimineya sa bahay n'yo?" Hindi naman sa nagmamaasim pero palaban ang chukchak ni Jouji sa tanong na, "Ikagagalit ba ng sinigang na mas maasim ka sa kan'ya?"

Ang totoong naasiman, si hurado Brent Manalo, dahil sa joke ng kaibigan niyang escort, Ralph de Leon. Pinakitaan pa niya si Ralph kung paano bumitaw ng pangmalakasang joke. Naging escort of the day rin si Darren Espanto, and true to his branding, ang mga jokes ni Darren idinaan sa singing.

Sa tiangge, dapat marunong tumawad. Dapat din naka-smile lang ang nagbebenta par ng swerte ay pumasok na. Kaya sa Laro Laro Pick, sold out ang good vibes at may sukli pang jackpot para sa mga players na tindera.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Alona, na halatang-halata ang saya nang makita nang personal si Vice Ganda. Pero maya-maya, si Meme Vice kinabahan. 'Yung tingin daw kasi ni Alona, parang may bulong.

No return, no exchange, sabi nila. Pero si palyer Maye, naka-return sa game arena matapos mabunot ang pangalan niya. Naniniwala siyang kalooban ng Panginoon ang paglalaro niya sa jackpot round kung saan umabot na sa P400,000 ang POT money.

Nag-goodbye si Maye sa P40,000 Li-Pot offer at sinugalan ang katanungan na may kinalaman sa 13th month pay ng isang private employee. Higit pa nga sa 13th month pay ang biyayang dumating kay Maye dahil nasungkit nito ang POT question!

title: Vice Ganda NAPAGOD sa sagot ng 'Miss Q&A' candidates
description:
Representing mga kabataang matatayog ang pangarap at maaasahan sa anumang hamon, P-Pop group CLOUD 7, hindi inatrasan ang 'Oohh Lala Baby' dance challenge.

Parang kidlat na gumuguhit sa langit, ang mga kandidata ng 'Miss Q and A,' pasabog ang wit! Hindi nagpakabog sa isa't isa sina candidates Mima Linda, Shanaya, at Gel Balantac.

Sa magkabilang gilid, sina Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro, panay ang bulong kay Vice Ganda. Baka naman daw na-scam sila ni Mima Linda, na para bang pagpapanggap lang ang kabaklaan dahil sa awrahang matigas, 'yung tipong patutumbahin ang mga kalalakihan sa suntukan. Si Nicole Cordoves nga, hinarana't pinormahan!

May sariling 'amats' din si Shanaya, na idinaan sa dance steps ang pang-aasar kay Mima Linda. Samantalang si Gel, tahimik lang at tagaktak ang pawis habang nagpupuksaan ang dalawang kasama. Pawis, este, panis kayo sa kanya!

Maraming nasorpresa na si Gel pa ang naunang makasagot nang tama, matapos ang mahaba at nakakapagod na Round 1 kung saan litong-lito ang mga 'atecco' kung ano ang 'kidlat' at 'kulog' sa Ingles. Kaya today, mga ses? Sumunod kay Gel si Shanaya sa Round 2, samantalang si Mima Linda ay tuluyang nag-babu! Sino ang itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day? ‘Yung Mama ay blue, o ‘yung Papa ay red?

Sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena, lumaban nang masigasig ang mga taga-Santolan, Pasig. Si player Annes ang kinapitan ng swerte! Hindi pa man pumipili kung POT o Li-POT, feeling winner n si Annes sa kilig na hatid nina Ralph de Leon, Brent Manalo at Darren. 'Sana all' na lang talaga ang masasabi mo!

Mukhang may nainggit! Hala! Si Jackie Gonzaga, abang na abang, feel na feel ang eksena kasama ang tatlong gwapo! Pero ano 'tong chika?! Si Jackie, may ka-talking stage na taga-GMA?!

Umepek naman ang sales talk ng mga pogi, dahil si Annes, Li-POT ang pinili. Nag-uwi siya ng P20,000!

title: Miss Q&A candidates 'NAGKAINITAN' sa 1st weekly finals
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: MC at Lassy hindi nagpakabog sa Miss Q&A stage
description:
Hindi suspended ang good vibes dito sa "It's Showtime" dahil tuloy-tuloy lang ang buhos ng tawanan at happiness. Parang Signal No. 4 ang intensity ng biritan sa FUNanghalian handog nina "TNT Duets" 2 champs Christian Tibayan at Arvery Lagoring.

Pati ang "Ohhh Lala Baby," naging mapanakit! Pero kung duet lang naman ang usapan, lalaban ang pares nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto aka DaCkie d'yan! Eh, magpapakabog ba naman ang BreCkie?! Si Brent Manalo, nag-warm up pa, sabay 'da move' na siguradong kikiligin ka Dong digi digi dong! Aha!

Heto, may bago! Ralph de Leon at Lassy aka RalphSy! Hirit ni Lassy, kung siya ang pinili ni Ralph papunta sa kanyang puso, siguradong may papaldo!

Sa "Miss Q and A," kapag hindi alam ang sagot, you've got to shoot your shot, bes! Sabay ngiti at sabi ng, "And, I thank you!" Malakas ang arrive nina candidates JV Zeped, Audrey Zunega, at Carla Shuvee Medalla, na sa bawat hampas ng balakang sa pagrampa, ika'y mapapa-ohhh lala.

Sa "Wit Lang" kung saan sina Carla at Audrey ang nagharapan, nabunot ni Carla ang tanong na, "Payag ka kung passenger princess ka pero nakasabit ka?" Ang tanong naman kay Audrey, "Payag ka masarap ka magmahal pero wala kang panlasa?"

Mag-manicure ay 'di biro, maghapong nakayuko sa pagkuskos ng kuko. Kaya deserve ng mga madlang manikurista players ang isang masayang bonding at laro sa game arena.

It's giving girl power si nanay Lisa sa Laro Laro Pick. Ikinuwento niya ang hirap at sarap ng pagiging isang solo parent ngayong graduate na ang mga anak sa kolehiyo. Paldo naman sa kilig si Jelai dahil kay Vhong Navarro. At sa sobrang kilig, naligaw pa ang 'I love you' na para kay mister!

Ang naglaro sa jackpot, si Bhels, na 35 years nang itinataguyod ang pamilya sa pamamagitan ng mani-pedi. Kaya naman super deserve ni nanay ang P25,000 Li-Pot offer, na malaking ginhawa na para sa kan'yang pamilya.

title: Miss Pau 'LASING' nang sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Ang goal natin sa araw na 'to, maging masaya much. Kalimutan muna ang pighati at ang mga labi ay pintahan ng ngiti. Kalmahan muna ang mga puso, parang mga boses ng Sessionistas—Nyoy Volante, Kean Cipriano, Princss Velasco, at Sitti.

Laugh trip to the highest level kasi ang hatid nina Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Barbie Nhicole Gondra, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Kantahan sa malamig na FUNanghalian ang trip nila for today's video. Si Miss Pau, songwriting ang forte. Pagbirit naman ang talent ni Barbie. Pero lahat ng 'songerists' ay walang sinabi sa lakas ng loob ni Belle, na may balak pang mag-audition sa "Tawag Ng Tanghalan." Kaya, sample naman d'yan! Mukhang bagay nga kay Belle ang mag-TNT, dahil napansin ni Meme na kamukha nito si Sofronio Vasquez. Kaya naman si Belle, binansagan niyang Sofronia Vasquech.

Dahil benta kay Meme ang mga hirit nito, binigyan niya si Belle ng sariling entablado at pagkakataon na sagutin ang mga tanong na nabunot nina Miss Pau at Barbie sa Wit Lang round.

Kinontra ni Belle ang sagot ng dalawang kandidata. Dahil napatunayan ni Belle ang kakayahan sa tanungan, mukhang malaki ang pag-asa na makabalik siya sa Resbakan. Samantala, sa araw na 'to, kay Miss Pau ang korona bilang Reyna Talaka-Era.

Mula sa lugar na pinagmulan kasarinlan ng bayan, sumugod ang mga taga-Kawit, Cavite sa Laro Laro Pick game arena para subukan ang kanilang swerte.

Pagkatapos ng masasayang laro, ang naka-survive at umabante sa jackpot round ay ang proud housewife na si Yayie, na ilalaan ang mapapanalunan para suportahan ang pag-aaral at pangarap ng mga anak.

Para palakasin ang loob ni Yayie, binalikan ng 'Gen Z' hosts ang kanilang mga childhood dreams. Alam n'yo ba? Childhood dream ni Jackie Gonzaga na maging madre.

Back to the game, nakumbinsi ni Cianne Dominguez si Yayie na piliin ang Li-POT! Naku! Lagot! Alam pala ni Yayie ang tamang sagot!

title: Miss Q&A Jerica na-FEEL ang LAMBING ni Ryan
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?

title: You're Hired!
description:
After the "mysterious" death of a colleague, the doldrums of office life at DanRick Designs are given a surprise resuscitation when Miles Fuller and Dylan Kirkpatrick discover they are the lead candidates for a promotion. The timing of the advancement opportunity couldn't be more ideal for the entry-level employees. The Tech Center where Miles' voluntarily teaches inner city teens is low on funds, and Dylan is desperate to purchase the home his deceased father built by hand, before his mother is manipulated by his weasel stepdad to put it on the market. The pay increase from the promotion could resolve their dilemmas, except only one of them can win the job.

Peers and family deceive the young men into believing racial disparities always impact office politics, so assertive, yet questionable actions, may be necessary to level the playing field if they really want the job. Is ethical compromise justified for a moral cause? Miles and Dylan will journey down a rabbit hole that not only answers the question, but drops them in the middle of chaos and high jinks so wild, staying alive becomes more vital than the job!

With a colorful cast (literally) of quirky characters, You're Hired, explores both internal and external perceptions and struggles of race and identity. This social satire avoids political correctness, opting to poke fun at the ignorance and insecurities that create unnecessary division. Sometimes laughing at stereotypes is simply wiser than allowing them validity, especially in today's America.

title: Saolta 's Gaolta
description: In this light hearted Irish language series we meet seven groups of people in their own homes and discuss everything from family life, growing up, falling in love and having children.

title: Têtàtête(s)
description: Têtàtête(s)

title: Galaxy Angel S
description: Galaxy Angel special that contains 2 stories. During an infiltration of the Angels' base, Milfeulle grabs a grenade and runs off with it, sacrificing herself to save her friends. Later on, she wakes up, believing it all to have been a dream. Things seem off when Commander Volcott and the others can not see or hear her. Realizing she is now a ghost, Milfeulle must come to terms with memories of her friends, both good and bad. Commanders Mary and Volcott have been ordered to switch commands. Neither is very happy with the situation, but they make do. That is, until the Twin-star boys insult Commander Volcott's mustache. Enraged, he reverts to his old army self, the "White Supernova Wolf". The Angels try desperately to control their former leader while Mary sneaks off for some tea.

title: Werewolf Women of the S.S.
description: Rob Zombie's fake trailer for "Grindhouse" is a sendup of 1970s Nazisploitation films.

title: Léto s kovbojem
description: A young psychologist Doubravka (Daniela Kolárová) swimming in a pool meets Honza Machácek (Jaromír Hanzlík) who summers co-op cows nearby. Honza likes the racy girl at the first sight and his directness imposes on Doubravka too. They start to date. Honza comes from a big family, he was degraded to a cowboy when he had a tractor accident caused by alcohol and lost his driving license. In the summer cabin, Doubravka takes care of Bobo (Oldrich Vízner) - a student of medicine who prepares for an one exam for the third time. He is selfish and in his uncertainty he behaves to Doubravka uninterestedly and outrageously. Honza supposes Doubravka looks after a crazy person, yet soon he learns that Bobo is Doubravka's boy-friend. On the other hand, Doubravka finds a girl's name tattooed on Honza's arm and troubles come.

title: Studio S
description: "Studio S" was a Swedish TV show broadcast on SVT 1975 - 1984, hosted by Göran Elwin. It dealt with various social issues, featuring both experts and regular people.

title: Fashion 70's
description: Fashion 70's tells the story of four young people. The series starts with their lives as children during the Korean War and follows them into adulthood in the 1970's South Korea.

title: Possession(s)
description: When Frank sees something, he must have it. So when he finally has the opportunity to own a painting by Peter Booth, he is willing to do anything to get it. But, he is not the only one consumed by the desire to possess.

title: Perevody s vostotchnogo
description: He and She, both of them spend a Christmas night together. They did not meet each other although they shared the old house for many years. Their engagement took place only in the mirror image of the distant Japanese prose of Heian period.

title: Décrochage(s)
description: Sénart MicroLycée is a french college for students who have not terminated their college course. The goal is to bring those students up to Baccalaureat, using a very peculiar pedagogy.

title: Maestro(s)
description: Follows the relationship between a father and a son father and a son who are music conductors.

title: Dama s popugaem
description: A 40-year-old womanizer is resting on vacation by the warm sea. The sea, the beach , beautiful naked women, and it would seem, what else is needed? But a strange woman with a parrot attracts an experienced womanizer for something, for whom he spends the whole vacation.

title: Malchanie s dostoynstvo
description: Silence with Dignity is a documentary about the life and work of the famous Bulgarian film directors, the family of Irina Aktasheva and Hristo Piskov. It is a story about their emblematic films and of those whose realization was banned, the criteria according to which a film was classified as "too dangerous" under communism, the mechanisms of censorship, their persistence and creative survival and their silence charged with dignity. The film reveals unknown details of the history of Bulgarian cinema and the link between the political elite and the intellectuals at the time.

title: Oslo S
description: A series that explores the community at Oslo Central Station. It follows the work of the security guards, store owners, janitors and passengers.

title: S' agapao men... alla
description: Daphne and Pavlos, a young and open-minded couple, always try to navigate the ups and downs of life through discussion. But as friends and employers enter the equation, coexistence becomes a challenging task. However, love is above all.

title: Sluchay s Polyninym
description: An experienced commander of an air regiment, who had already fought in Spain, Colonel Polynin falls in love with twenty-seven-year-old metropolitan actress Galina Prokofieva.

title: Lyubov s pervogo vzglyada
description: A game show, where newly formed on-set pairs of contestants compete for prizes and/or hearts of each other in an assortment of romantic contests.

title: Saraswathi
description: A devoted mother's world crumbles when her 12-year-old daughter vanishes. Seeking police assistance, she encounters surprising turns that complicate the case. What truly occurred?

title: Morena(s)
description: A Dominican immigrant in Buenos Aires struggles to maintain afloat her business and the dream of bringing her teenage son to Argentina.

title: Shag s kryshi
description: A magic raven helps Vitka Paramonov to visit different eras, beginning with the stone age and then working forward in time.

title: M8's House
description: A Mockumentary about a group of Australian low life's who mess around, like having fun but they put themselves in very inconvenient situations.

title: Podarok s kharakterom
description: Being panda is fun, but not for 30 years old Misha, who is forced to work wearing panda suit at children's parties to earn money for living. But everything changes when a Moscow oligarch invites him to work at his son's birthday ..

title: S. O. S. Iceberg
description: An expedition goes in search of a party lost the year before.

title: Devushka s kosoy
description: The residents of a Moscow condominium would face lots of funny yet thrilling events right before the New Year. A girl with scythe is coming. Would she find her way, or would everyone celebrate the holiday safe and healthy?..

title: The K.E.OP/S System
description: After finding he is spied on by a secret organization, a screenwriter tries to discover who is stalking him. With the help of an old friend of his, he falls into a maze of problems, and his only way out is by throwing a few punches.

title: Dom s liliyami
description: This is a saga of a war hero, Michail Govorov, and his big family. The film will follow several generations of people from World War 2 into modern days. Thanks to being in the Communist Party's good graces, Michail is assigned to take the Regional Party Leader position. He accepts the offer and moves his family to a nice house outside of town. An atheist and a pragmatic Michail doesn't pay attention to provincial superstitions and oldwives' tales about the house he's currently living in. Legend has it that whoever takes up residence in the house will forever taint his bloodline with the curse of living lives devoid of love...

title: Tocad@s
description: Tocad@s is a Spanish-language documentary series that centers on the lives of creatives, artists and artisans behind some of the most popular brands in Spain.

title: T-Rex
description: In the wake of local car salesman Marty Dickens' mysterious death a chain of events is set in motion that destabilizes the lives of several people in a Midwestern city. This black and white film follows a range of eccentric characters including a corrupt lawyer, nightclub singer, a self-obsessed academic, and a recovering alcoholic as they search for love and meaning in their lives.

title: Violent Sh*t
description: A demented, wicked, deformed, cannibalistic killer named K. The Butcher Shitter, escapes from the police and slaughters people in many gory, bloody ways.

title: Uncle T
description: When carefree bachelor Fred T gets a visit from his military sister. He is asked to watch her kids, which are his niece and nephew due to her being deployed. Now he must adjust to his new living style and maintain his single lifestyle.

title: T-Bag Strikes Again
description: T. Bag has regained her powers and calls her former servant, Thomas, into a storybook and makes him serve her tea again as 'T.Shirt'. Debbie follows her friend and soon discovers she has to locate all the silver numbers from the town clock that T.Bag has hidden in the book's various chapters.

title: More Than T
description: A full-length documentary that depicts the multidimensional lives of seven transgender and gender non-conforming individuals.

title: Don't Move
description: Set on one fateful night, six friends gather for their monthly 'games night'... and accidentally unleash a demonic force that might tear them - and their friendships - to pieces.

title: Dr. T and the Women
description: A wealthy gynecologist's ideal life is thrown into turmoil when the women closest to him begin to affect his life in unexpecting ways.

title: 100% T-Shirt
description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

title: The Good Sh*t
description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

title: U me dobrý
description: A poetic comedy set in a pub situated on an inlet and called At the Ferryman's, which is run by pub-keeper Tonda (Jirí Schmitzer) and his companion Andula (Lenka Vlasáková). Among the pub-goers is Kája (Miroslav Vladyka), who compensates for his tendency to gamble (thanks to which is marriage is on the rocks) by playing cards at the pub with his friends. Besides his salary as a security guard at an art gallery, he has saved a pretty penny over the years by posing as a chimney sweep for newlyweds' photos, and now he wants to use it to give his wife (Simona Babcáková) a long-promised seaside holiday, a promise which breathes new life into their relationship. But in a moment of weakness, Kája loses all of his savings playing the shell game at the marketplace. So as not to lose the rekindled love of his wife, he requests the help of his friends from the pub. Combining their forces, they eventually manage to slam the shell-game gang and recover his money. The whole experience has a profound effect on Kája, who learns a lesson from the scare, confirms his friendship with the others, and realizes just how important they are to him.

title: U Turn
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

title: Francesca Next Door
description: Woo-ju, a model student and class president who has devoted everything to getting into medical school, finds his life turned upside down when Pi Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. After accidentally becoming the keeper of her secret, Woo-ju finds himself looking after both her studies and school life. As the two constantly bicker and clash, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom between them, leaving Na-young increasingly confused as she struggles to tell whether her racing heart for Woo-ju is the feeling of falling in love or simply her vampire instincts.

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: Spartacus: House of Ashur - Soundtrack | Ashur Ascends | John Hannah & Lucy Lawless | Starz 9p
description:
Step into the blood-stained sands of Capua with Ashur Ascends, an original track inspired by the upcoming Spartacus: House of Ashur. This atmospheric piece blends ancient percussion, war-drums, and haunting Eastern melodies to capture the ruthless rise of Ashur — the most cunning schemer in the gladiator world.

Before Spartacus ever set foot in the arena, Ashur was already weaving lies, alliances, and betrayals inside the House of Batiatus. This track is crafted to reflect his transformation from a struggling gladiator to a master manipulator navigating Roman politics, violence, and survival.

Spartacus: House of Ashur is expected to release in late 2025 / early 2026 and will stream exclusively on Starz.
If you're a fan of the original Spartacus series, gladiator lore, intense character arcs, and cinematic soundscapes, this one’s for you.

Welcome to Popcorn & Tracks — where stories meet sound.

#Spartacus #HouseOfAshur #AshurAscends #PopcornAndTracks #SpartacusSeries #StarzOriginal #

description: Woo-ju, a model student and class president who has devoted everything to getting into medical school, finds his life turned upside down when Pi Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. After accidentally becoming the keeper of her secret, Woo-ju finds himself looking after both her studies and school life. As the two constantly bicker and clash, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom between them, leaving Na-young increasingly confused as she struggles to tell whether her racing heart for Woo-ju is the feeling of falling in love or simply her vampire instincts.

title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.
