title: Not Your Family Man
description: Micro Drama

title: The Haunted Honeymoon
description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

title: King in Disguise
description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

title: Final Breakup
description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

title: Payback for Parivaar
description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

title: Adha Pyar
description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

title: Delivery King
description: A humble delivery man is mocked by everyone, but behind his ordinary appearance lies a business genius with unimaginable wealth and influence. As he repeatedly saves a powerful CEO from financial ruin, shocking secrets about his true identity leave his enemies stunned and his allies questioning everything.

title: Ikka Number Paanch
description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino. There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

title: Khamosh Dil
description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

title: He comes from the mountains  [Hindi]
description: .He comes from the mountains

title: Million Dollar Mother [Hindi]
description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.

title: Raja Sahab Returns
description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

title: Unworthy Love
description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

title: Autowala Billionaire
description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

title: Jamai on EMI [Hindi]
description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

title: Bulletproof Ishq
description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!

title: Arranged to Love
description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

title: Lady Boss Returns
description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

title: We, the Emperor
description: Watch "We, the Emperor" Only On KUKKU TV!

title: God Of Cricket
description: A Janitor is a hidden fireball bowler who saves a cricket team from losing the Delhi premiere league.

title: The Undercover Lady CEO
description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

title: Ready Daddy Go!
description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

title: Ek Anjana Rishta
description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

title: Betrayed Heiress
description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

title: College Romance Aur Dhoka
description: College Romance

title: One Last Chance [Hindi]
description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

title: Lost In Love [Hindi]
description: Jab pyaar sirf ek emotion nahi, balki ek dangerous game ban jaata hai, tab har rishta ek nayi twist leta hai. Elle, Ethan aur Jannette ke beech ka yeh triangle sirf love story nahi, ek intense emotional rollercoaster hai jahan trust, betrayal aur revenge sab kuch hai. To ready ho jao ek gripping kahani ke liye jo har episode ke saath aur complicated hoti jaati hai. Abhi dekhna shuru kijiye.

title: Joker Ka Wild Card
description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

title: Dulhan Se Darling
description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

title: Secret Prince
description: So, our hero, born into a super-rich family, is about to be named the next heir to their business empire. But according to their family tradition, the person taking the position has to learn the ropes for 3 months by working at another business, hiding their real identity. That's exactly what our hero does.. He hides who he is and starts working at a business family's place. That's where he meets our heroine, who's already engaged to someone else. Love starts blooming in his heart, too. Now, what's our hero going to do? Is he going to stick to the family tradition? Or is he going to give up the family's custom to marry his girlfriend

title: The Magical Husband
description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Vaishali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

title: Billionaire Became Beggar
description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

title: The Great Indian Cook
description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
description: After five years in hiding, a legendary racer disguised as a mechanic must return to the track to save his village, igniting a high-octane rivalry with the current world champion. Watch now!

title: Billionaire Heist
description: A billionaire with unlimited funds but no proof, Dharam Khurana is trapped in a system that refuses to believe him. As hours tick down and humiliation piles up, one decision changes everything. What begins as a simple plea turns into a dangerous game of power, ego, and survival.

title: Dad With A Dark Side
description: Aravind Varma is an ordinary cleaner. Anu, the CEO of Aditya Group of Hotels, develops feelings for him. Even though he has a son who is of marriageable age, will Aravind marry Anu? The story revolves around the hidden secret in the life of an ordinary cleaner.

title: Shattered Bonds [Kannada]
description: When railway ticket checker (TT/ TC) Ishwar Pratap retires after 40 years of honest service, his three biological children reveal their cruel indifference, forcing him and his devoted wife Rajni into a humiliating separation - until his adopted son Prem and a book of love poems expose the truth about family, sacrifice, and the price of unconditional love.

title: The Sweeper Billionaire
description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

title: The Street Beggar to Billionaire
description: The Street Beggar to Billionaire

title: Dhurandhar Shooter
description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

title: Still Waiting for Love [Kannada]
description: Still Waiting for Love

title: Secretary Rosie [Kannada]
description: She wasn’t just a secretary. She was temptation wrapped in silk, whispering promises that blurred the line between loyalty and lust. With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
description: When enchantment mage Rein is dismissed from his guild after buffing all their gear, he reclaims every enhancement for himself. Armed with only basic equipment and stolen power, he embarks on an overpowered adventure from scratch.

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

She leaves the Southland where they live, taking her infant son Stephen. When Stephen has grown to manhood, his mother dies, first telling him the story of Miles' persecution. Horrified, Dagmar flees from the church and returns to America. In a whimsical mood, and partly to atone for the wrongs he had done in his past, Miles makes a will leaving his $10 million fortune to Dagmar and Stephen, provided that they marry and that the wedding takes place before midnight of the following May 31. Miles does not know of Dagmar's wedding and dies before she arrives in America. Stephen is notified of the contents of the strange will at a trading station in Africa. He decides he will take no assistance from his uncle, and with Timothy O'Farrell, a companion, he plans a way out of it. They find the body of a white man floating in the river, and Stephen puts all his papers and trinkets in the pockets of the dead man. Mark Seager, a gunrunner, finds the body and conceives the idea of impersonating the dead man, marrying Dagmar, and claiming the legacy. He sets off for America immediately. title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. In the meantime police investigators are arresting catholic clergy for supplying the saboteurs with weapons and false documents. Soldiers are operating in the area of Small Fatra, and it seems there must be someone amongst them who provides the Bandera's with information about planned movements of the army.

title: Plan B

title: Urlau(b)
description: For a long time, the village of Urlau at the foot of the Allgäu Alps was only known for its ammunition arsenal. Cäcilia Angerer still remembers the looming catastrophe during World War II. But lately Urlau has been sprucing itself up because a huge resort is about to be built where toxic warfare ammunition was once stored. Christian Skrodzki has been planning a community project to give an old factory building in the village a new purpose. The Wehr family has been preparing their vacation apartment for rent. Things are going well for the region, but suddenly it is proclaimed: "Stay home!"

title: Plan B

title: From C to C: Chinese Canadian Stories of Migration
description: Beautifully filmed in Canada and China's Guangdong province, From C to C is a moving, cinematic tapestry of Chinese Canadian stories of migration. Contrasting the historical injustices faced by Chinese migrants to Canada and their families over the last century, are the experiences of contemporary Chinese Canadian youth who embody diverse, transnational identities across Canada today.

title: Capital C
description: CAPITAL C is the first documentary about crowdfunding. It follows the hopes and dreams as well as the fears and pitfalls of a whole new generation of independent creators, who reach out to the crowd in order to change their lives forever.

title: C.I.C.: Central de Inteligência Cearense
description: A secret agent from the Ceará Intelligence Center is Brazil's last hope to recover stolen data about a top-secret project, that threatens to destroy the country's beaches.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: C Students
description: C students is a 20 minute episode of a YouTube series made by AnimatedJames. It follows the adventures of a Dull and Sarcastic pessimist named August, a Girl crazy pervert named Kevin, and a smart girl named Penny, who never fits in with other girls. The Trio get into misadventures and shenanigans at their school.

title: C.E.O.
description: Ling Min becomes the manager of Haier Factory when the factory is almost bankrupted. He has had no formal education, but on his own, he systematically studies Western theories of industrial management and such classical Chinese philosophies as Confucianism, Taoism, and Suntzu. His first challenge is from the Chinese workers, technicians, and officers, who have been trained to work under the old system and unable to function sufficiently in the new era of international competition. Once his products become good enough, he has to face severe competition, and, in some cases, humiliations, from well-established foreign companies. He and his company succeed in becoming the first Chinese private company to enter the international market, because of hard work, scientific management, and the combination of Western and Eastern philosophy.

title: Road to Success
description: The drama is adapted from the same-titled youth and passionate sports competition novel by author Chang E from Jinjiang Literature City. Doctoral student Lin Wansheng suddenly returns to his hometown and takes up a job as a sports equipment keeper at Hongjing No. 8 Middle School. Wang Fa gives up his job as a coach at a British football club and returns to Hongjing, becoming Lin Wansheng's mysterious tenant. Lin Wansheng is asked to lead the disbanded football team to participate in the league. As expected, they are beaten to a pulp. Thanks to Wang Fa's guidance, they manage to win the game with great difficulty. After that, Lin Wansheng persuades Wang Fa to become the coach, gathers the team members and resolves the internal conflicts. When everything seems to be on the right track, the old wounds of Wang Fa and Lin Wansheng are successively exposed. Both of them choose to escape, but eventually they understand each other. The final of the children's football match and the college entrance examination are approaching. The two join hands to help the children regain their love for football, strive for the college entrance examination and embark on the road to pursue their dreams.

title: Oops! The Alpha's Bride Is a Boy
description: After an unforgettable night with a mysterious man, Fenrir never expects to see him again—until he discovers the stranger is Lucien, the powerful Alpha of the Lusen Family. When Fenrir's twin sister Chloe elopes, he is forced to take her place in a one-month trial marriage with Lucien. Now he must keep his true identity hidden as their forbidden bond grows and the power buried within him begins to awaken.

title: C-38: The Search for Marriage
description: On June 22nd, 2005, Bill C-38 passed a final reading in the House of Commons, making Canada the fourth country in history to officially sanction same-sex marriages. Some saw it as the final hurdle in a 40-year marathon for equality. To others, it undermined an age-old building block of society. This controversial legislation continues to divide the country, and indeed the world, in half. Through interviews with the public as well as experts in various fields, 'C-38: The Search for Marriage' challenges common notions about marriage, sexuality and equality to answer these and other fundamental questions from an equal and fair perspective.

title: Blues Run the Game: The Strange Tale of Jackson C. Frank
description: In the mid-60s, Jackson C. Frank released a masterpiece of folk music in Britain. This young American songwriter was close to Simon & Garfunkel, Bert Jansch, John Renbourn, Al Stewart, Roy Harper, Sandy Denny and many others. All of them were influenced by this enigmatic and tormented character. Shortly after the release of his unique album, he disappeared. Wrecked by a series of tragedies in his life, he chose to cut himself off from the world and got trapped by his demons. Still today, young musicians like John Mayer, Laura Marling or Robin Pecknold perform Blues Run the Game. This documentary follows Jackson C. Frank's footsteps to unknot the threads of a tragic destiny. Facts and songs don't express everything about a man, a personality. Who was Jackson C. Frank? Who remembers him? Where to find meaning, or even light, in a life as dark as his?

title: Murder of Innocence
description: Newlywed Laurie Wade's deeply-rooted psychotic behavior shatters her marriage, and eventually her entire life. She goes from brief "short circuits" to overtly murderous behavior. The film never tries to explain the cause of her mental collapse, except for a hint or two, but instead takes the viewer into her frightening state of mind.

title: Daniel C. Dennett: Do Lobsters Have Free Will?
description: Daniel C. Dennett is the most influential contemporary philosopher of the mind and a great reformer in the field of knowledge. title: CEO's Cute Charm For Love
description: Song Yujia and Lu Huanyu's new drama begins with a special marriage. In the marriage, the man went abroad with a third party, and the two lived based on an agreement not to interfere with each other. The heroine Xu Wenyan chose to support a gigolo in response. Two years later, when her husband, who was married in disguise, returned to China, it foreshadowed the resurgence of this complicated relationship - Xu Wenyan's relationship with the gigolo came to an end. At the same time, the prince of the Beijing circle, who had been silently supporting the heroine, decided not to hide his true feelings and identity anymore, and strived to spend the rest of his life with the heroine as a formal partner, starting a battle for love and identity.

title: Perfect and Casual
description: It tells the romantic story between Zhang Sinian, the aloof and monastic "Mr. Perfect" and Yun Shu, the laid-back and cheerful "Miss Almost".

title: [ENG DUB] Against the Odds: Cici's Second Act
description: In her past life, Cici was killed by her husband, Yates. However, she miraculously reincarnated and returned to the day she first met Yates's family. This time, Cici decisively chose Yates' uncle, Benson. Despite rumors claiming that Benson was sterile, Cici found herself pregnant with triplets and was spoiled by Benson!

title: No Sword Can Rival Hers
description: At five, she slew a dragon—then hid her sword for thirteen years. Old law: women who wield swords are crippled or killed. Her aunt won a duel disguised as a man; she was broken and jailed for thirteen years. Now her family falls. Vera disguises as Gavin, sweeps the royal trials, and when orcs storm the capital, she kills the Orc King. The old law dies. Girls can wield swords openly—and Vera frees her aunt.

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Hear Me, Mommy? Now Let's Get Rich!
description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. Ann soon learns that the powerful Lowe family and her father, Cory Lowe, plan to cast Eva aside because she is carrying a daughter. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: Love, Lost and Found（DUBBED）
description: Mia Sanders, a kind-hearted young woman, has been labeled as a jinx by her family from the day she was born. Not only does her father treat her as if she's invisible, but even the household servants look down on her. In stark contrast, her twin sister, Molly Sanders, is the favored one. Molly subjects Mia to ceaseless mistreatment and oppression, and Mia can only endure it. She holds onto the belief that she can escape this life once she grows up and moves out.

title: Swallowed Star S1-S2
description: This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Mais Loïc, qui en a assez de ramper, décide d'exploiter un bug du système pour empocher d'énormes sommes d'argent, et pour s'acheter tout ce qu'il désire. Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Stellar Transformation S1-S6
description: In order to gain the respect of his father, a kid without innate ability to practice internal techniques, resolutely chooses to follow the more difficult path of practicing external techniques. Will he be able to gain his father's respect?

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: A Love That Devours（DUBBED）
description: In the game of love, Rey Quinn has always been the conqueror—the ruthless plunderer. He gives Sonia Reed ten days to surrender while executing his own plans, shattering her once-stable life like a predator. Yet before he can claim victory, Rey finds himself stepping down from his throne, consumed by an obsession that only grows stronger each day.

description: A battle royale between superhumans takes place for the title of X, the most popular hero.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

description: Si-Ah has no idea that her childhood friend Jun-Woo has been in love with her all his life. title: Midnight Breaks
description: When sweet-voiced Cassie (Dawn Hope) of unsigned reggae act Midnight is offered a lucrative deal to join successful group Breaks by record company rep Billy (Toyah Willcox), her bandmate boyfriend Tyron (Letts) is less than thrilled.

title: Sleep With My Husband's Brother
description: After her parents were murdered, she married into the enemy's family under a false name to protect her unconscious brother and find out the truth. An unexpected misflirtation accidentally provoked the vicious second master who fell in love with her at first sight.

title: A Love Paid in Tears
description: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

title: Rooftops
description: A touring musician returns home to spend time with old friends and an old flame for a day. Just as times begin to feel right again, she has to reckon with leaving again.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: Love Unexpected
description: A sweet love story between an emotionally detached CEO and a female bodyguard who is full of empathy.

title: (Dubbed) She Took Everyone on Vacation Except Me!
description: (Dubbed) She Took Everyone on Vacation Except Me!

title: A Twist of Fate
description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. As adults, a twist of fate brought them together, but Laurel, fearing rejection, chose to hide her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else impersonated her, leading to a series of misunderstandings. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

title: My Annoying Roommate
description: In the second semester of her junior year, 17-year-old Su Qiao welcomed her new desk mate, the "big celebrity" Lin Zilu. However, his appearance immediately brought misfortune to Su Qiao.

title: One Punch Man vs. Mosquito
description: Is One-Punch Man unbeatable or did a mosquito expose him? The unending battle between man and bug rages on.

title: A Summertime Drug
description: Stand up Comedian Louis C vents about his childhood, adulthood and relentless failures with relationships. A Summertime Drug was filmed during back to back nights for 2 sold out crowds at The Stage Door in Elko, NV.

title: Veil of Vengeance: The Woman in Disguise
description: After her marriage to Shawn Holt is destroyed by Sherry Lind, Penny Lind loses the family she tried so hard to protect. Seeking revenge, she transforms into Xandra Ford and returns to make Sherry pay for her actions. However, Zack Green mistakenly believes Xandra is responsible for Penny’s disappearance and stands in her way.

title: RICH GIRL REBORN:GOING CRAZY FOR LOVE
description: Choi Cheong-yeon and Kim Myeong-nam are lovers whose relationship is tested time and again. A crisis at her family’s company and a web of complicated relationships leave Cheong-yeon struggling. Though Myeong-nam remains devoted to her, misunderstandings and sinister schemes drive them apart. Caught in the plots of Park Yong-jun and Choi Hyo-jin, the couple endure countless hardships, with Myeong-nam even suffering a life-threatening injury. Yet their love and trust help them expose the conspiracies and overcome every obstacle. Myeong-nam thwarts Yong-jun’s plans and saves the Choi Group, while Cheong-yeon clears her family’s name. Finally united, they prove that true love can conquer even the greatest challenges.

title: The Hunt of the Son of Beast
description: Andrew, David and his friends are taking a vacation to Kings Island when something strange and mysterious is happening and it's returning.

title: Perfect and Casual [Hindi]
description: It tells the romantic story between Zhang Sinian, the aloof and monastic "Mr. Perfect" and Yun Shu, the laid-back and cheerful "Miss Almost".

title: One fateful Night with My Neighbor Boss（DUBBED）
description: After a one-night stand with Kim Tae-on, Yoon Ha-jung gives birth to twins. However, her ruthless stepsister, Yoon Se-ra, secretly steals one of the babies and claims the child as her own. She becomes Kim Tae-on's fiancee through deception. Six years later, Yoon Ha-jung returns under a new identity—the famous perfumer, Arta.

title: Secret Baby, Billionaire Daddy(Dubbed)
description: To investigate his mother's death, Mason becomes a taxi driver and has a one-night stand with beautiful CEO Victoria. Years later, she returns with their daughter and proposes to him. When she's humiliated at a banquet, Mason's billionaire father steps in, revealing his real identity.

title: The Eight-Year-Old Patriarch Return of the Supreme Mage
description: Supreme Mage Merlin wakes after a century, turns the Hell King into a goat mount, and returns home. His family is being destroyed by the Malphas family. He lifts his sister’s curse, defeats the three-headed hellhound, and begins his counterattack.

title: Legend of Yun Xi
description: A young naive girl skilled in magical medicine and poisons meets cruel power struggle, villains, friends and love.

title: Secretary Ye's Attached Boss
description: A girl, solely chosen as the personal secretary because of her resemblance to the CEO's first love, spent five years by his side. She believed her own love story had finally arrived, only to discover that he was about to get engaged...

title: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage
description: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage

title: Werewolf King's Hidden Heir
description: Human girl Nellie, drunk, stumbles into werewolf king Clifford's territory, has a one-night stand with him, and flees. Five years later, she applies to be his family doctor for her sick son Brady—only to discover her employer is the man from that night. Recognizing her, Clifford relentlessly pursues her while Brady's werewolf blood awakens. Werewolf nobles repeatedly frame Brady as a "cursed child" and try to kill him, but Clifford protects his family. At their wedding, he exposes the conspiracy and proves Brady's pure lineage. Nellie accepts his proposal, Brady gains the pack's acceptance, and the three live happily ever after.

title: The Land of Warriors
description: After the finals, Tang San parts ways with friends for five years of training. He reunites them to form the Tang Sect and confront Bibi Dong's sinister ambitions, protecting the Douluo Continent.

title: (Doublage) HUMILIÉ, JE REVIENS EN MAÎTRE
description: (Doublage) HUMILIÉ, JE REVIENS EN MAÎTRE

title: Mecha Underdog
description: Jax Thorne, the legendary 5-time mecha champion, was betrayed and discarded by his club for being "too old." Left penniless, he’s taken in by Amy, the beautiful owner of a failing gym, hiding his identity as a humble mechanic. But when ruthless rivals push Amy to the brink, the King must rise. With his secret SSS-class mecha, Phoenix, Jax is ready to crush his betrayers and claim his queen!

title: Only Tamed for You
description: Joan White, heir to the White Group, was betrayed by her sister and fiancé, left for dead at sea. She survived, but with the mind of a child. Taken in by the mysterious Tommy Frim, they married in a flash. He doted on her, and love quietly bloomed.But after a blow to the head at a party,Joan's memories return. With her past restored, will her revenge begin?

title: Rejected Siren, Chosen by the Prince
description: Voiceless Alicia trusts Rayne, unaware she's a pawn in his revenge. Forced to marry the "Mad Prince" Kane, she's framed and tortured as Rayne watches. Her hidden bloodline awakens. At Rayne's engagement, she exposes the lies, leaving proudly with Kane. Kane isn't mad—just tormented by the sea's cries—and together they heal. Consumed by obsession, Rayne wages war for her but fails. He's imprisoned; Shelly ruined. Voice restored, Alicia guards the deep sea with Kane.

title: Married to a Billionaire in Disguise
description: On the eve of her wedding, Emily Green catches her fiancé cheating. In a fit of anger, she impulsively marries a handsome beggar she meets by chance. What starts as a simple life with a doting husband takes a shocking turn when she discovers her "beggar" husband is actually a billionaire CEO!

title: The Princess's Gambit
description: A former princess enters an arranged marriage with a prime minister. Amidst political turmoil, she navigates loyalty conflicts, vengeance, and love while he conceals patriotic motives behind his ambitions.

description: Chen Chang Sheng was abandoned in a flowing river and plucked up by a Taoist monk. He's plagued with an incurable illness, fated not to live past the age of 20. To find a cure, he leaves his temple to become a student at a famous academy.

title: Vengeance in Disguise: Walk in Shadows, Strike in Fire
description: Victor Vance, once the sole heir of a prestigious family, became the only survivor after rivals slaughtered the family to seize their heirloom. Ten years later, Victor returns seeking revenge. His childhood love, Viola Joyner, has never forgotten him. She buried his parents and visits their grave every year. While avenging his family, Victor conceals his identity to remain by her side, but ultimately, to protect her, he is forced to reveal it.

title: Blossoms of Power
description: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Qingzhi Gu awakens under a new identity as Xihe Shen, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Huayong Xiao, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

title: The Heir
description: In the middle of Ming Dynasty, a tribute ink case broke the long-standing pattern of Huizhou ink industry, and Li Mo, a century-old family of ink making, fell to the altar. Li Mo's vitality was greatly damaged, and the ink industry of the Luo family rose, and the scenery was no two after Li Mo. Finally, due to the involvement of the government, the family was also destroyed. As time goes by, Li Zhen (Yang Zi is acted the role of), the eighth female of the Li clan, resolutely embarked on the road of making ink to solve the livelihood, and became the dark horse of Huizhou ink industry with talent and efforts. Luo Wenqian, the second son of the Locke family (Han Dongjun is acted the role of) to restore the layout of the family business, to stir up the pattern of Huizhou ink industry. They two people and ink industry upstart field ink family battle of wits and courage, Li Mo back to the top. In the face of the challenges of overseas ink industry, Li Zhen collected the essence of Huizhou ink industry, produced top ink products, and won the reputation of "the first ink in the world" for Huizhou ink. Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian finally got married and worked together to promote the passing down of Huizhou ink to the world.
